quarterly_data.signal: Company on reciprocal tariffs and currency risk: export sales of its flagship manufacturing equipment are highly dependent on the U.S. dollar (approximately 70%), and production costs rely heavily on manufacturing in Greater China (key facilities include the Tsurugashima, Saitama headquarters and the Shanghai plant). Although it relies heavily on the Greater China region for exports, its end-users are spread globally with a focus on the U.S. market; in response to the impact of reciprocal tariffs, the company plans to expand its production and development infrastructure by establishing bases in India, Japan, Vietnam and the Greater China region.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 70% of flagship equipment export sales in U.S. dollars
